newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chekiang First Bank raises FRCD to HK$1.25 bln.
newsitem.headline: Chekiang First Bank raises FRCD to HK$1.25 bln.

text.p: Chekiang First Bank has raised its floating rate certificate of deposit issue to HK$1.25 billion from HK$1.0 billion, arranger DBK Asia said Friday.
Hong Kong-based Chekiang First Bank is a wholly owned subsidiary of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank.
The three-year notes pay a margin of 33 basis points and, with fees, an all-in return of 42 basis points.
Coordinating arrangers, with HK$100 million each, are Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale Hong Kong branch, DKB Asia, Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp and Schroders Asia.

Arrangers, with HK$95 million each, are Banque Nationale de Paris Hong Kong branch, Fuji International Finance (HK), Jardine Fleming Bank, Standard Chartered Bank, Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale and Westpac Banking Corp Hong Kong branch.
Co-lead managers, with HK$70 million each, are Bank Austria Hong Kong branch and Sakura Finance Asia.
Bank Commerciale Italiana Hong Kong branch is a senior manager with HK$50 million.
Managers, with HK$30 million each, are Baden Wurttembergische Bank, Banca di Roma Hong Kong branch and Berliner Bank.
